entities.name: 5GMM STATUS
entities.description: A 5GMM status message received by the UE from the network.

entities.name: No state transition
entities.description: Condition specifying that receipt of 5GMM STATUS message does not cause any state transition as seen from the radio interface.

entities.name: No specific action
entities.description: Condition specifying that receipt of 5GMM STATUS message does not require any specific action as seen from the radio interface.

entities.name: Local actions
entities.description: Local actions that may be taken by the UE upon receipt of a 5GMM STATUS message, which are implementation dependent.

relations.description: Receipt of 5GMM STATUS message establishes that no state transition occurs.
Receipt of 5GMM STATUS message establishes that no specific action is required.
Receipt of 5GMM STATUS message may establish implementation-dependent local actions in the UE.
